mapper.select: SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, A.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, A.FSUBJECT_NO AS fsubjectId, A.BAL_FLAG AS balFlagHappenDate, A.O_CCY AS oCcy, A.O_AMT AS balance, A.O_C_AMT AS cAmt, A.O_D_AMT AS dAmt, A.NUM_AMT AS num, A.IS_LEAF AS isLeaf, A.SUBJECT_LEVEL as subjectLevel, A.BALANCE_DATE balanceDate, A.SUBJECT_LEVEL subjectLevel, A.BAL_CO_FLAG balCoFlag, A.O_CO_AMT oCcyKnotsAmt, A.O_CO_C_AMT oCcyKnotsAmtC, A.O_CO_D_AMT oCcyKnotsAmtD, A.B_CCY bCcy, A.B_AMT bAmt, A.B_C_AMT bCAmt, A.B_CO_AMT bCoAmt, A.B_CO_C_AMT bCoCAmt, A.B_CO_D_AMT bCoDAmt, A.B_D_AMT bDAmt, 0 tdyOAmt, 0 tdyOCAmt, 0 tdyODAmt, 0 tdyOCoAmt, 0 tdyOCoCAmt, 0 tdyOCoDAmt, 0 tdyBAmt, 0 tdyBCAmt, 0 tdyBDAmt, 0 tdyBCoAmt, 0 tdyBCoCAmt, 0 tdyBCoDAmt, A.TDY_AMT_FLAG tdyAmtFlag, A.TDY_CO_FLAG tdyCoFlag, 0 tdyPurODUlamt, 0 tdyRedODUlamt, 0 tdyPurOCUlamt, 0 tdyRedOCUlamt, 0 tdyPurBDUlamt, 0 tdyRedBDUlamt, 0 tdyPurBCUlamt, 0 tdyRedBCUlamt, CASE WHEN A.SUBJECT_LEVEL = '99' THEN D.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE ELSE C.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE END as baseSubjectNature FROM BOK_BALANCE A LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON bb.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND C.SUBJECT_NO = A.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT D ON D.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND D.SUBJECT_NO = A.FSUBJECT_NO WHERE A.BALANCE_DATE = #{queryDate} AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, A.BOOK_DATE AS bookDate, NVL(B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO, B.SUBJECT_NO) AS subjectNo, B.CD_FLAG AS balFlagHappenDate, B.CCY AS oCcy, B.HAPPEN_AMT AS balance, B.HAPPEN_NUMBER AS num, B.B_HAPPEN_AMT AS bAmt, B.B_CCY AS bCcy, ( CASE WHEN B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN B.SUBJECT_NO ELSE C.FSUBJECT_ID END ) AS fsubjectId, ( CASE WHEN B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN #{bottomLevel} ELSE C.SUBJECT_LEVEL END ) AS subjectLevel, 0 AS dAmt, 0 AS cAmt, NULL AS isleaf, B.TABLE_ID tableId FROM BOK_VOUCH_DETAIL B JOIN BOK_VOUCH_MAIN A ON A.VOUCH_NUM = B.VOUCH_NUM LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON bb.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND C.SUBJECT_NO = B.SUBJECT_NO
WHERE A.BOOK_DATE = #{bookDate} AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT bs.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, bs.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, bs.FSUBJECT_ID AS fsubjectId, bs.SUBJECT_LEVEL AS subjectLevel, bs.BAL_FLAG AS balFlag, bs.SUBJECT_TYPE AS subjectType FROM BOK_SUBJECT bs,BOK_BOOKSET bb WHERE bb.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND bs.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL
